description: Trunk: portal login as superadmin with ComC grant, verify dashboard loads with 7 pillar nav, save browser state.

steps.description: TRUNK FRESH LOGIN — DO NOT load any browser state file. This journey CREATES the session. Do NOT call browser_set_storage_state. Start fresh: use browser_tabs to close all tabs except the current one. Use browser_evaluate to wipe the service worker cache: 'await caches.keys().then(ks => Promise.all(ks.map(k => caches.delete(k))))'. Then navigate directly to http://localhost:3002/auth/login?t=Date.now() (cache-bust). VERIFY the login form is visible (email+password fields must be present in the snapshot). Fill email 'qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com' and password 'QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD'. Submit and wait for the portal sidebar to appear. Mark failed if redirected to a non-login page before credentials are submitted.

Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/dashboard. Verify the ComC dashboard section loads without a 500 error or blank white screen. The dashboard main area should show stat cards (Org Health, Active Agents, Pending Approvals). Verify NO JavaScript TypeError appears in the browser console — if 'toFixed' or 'Cannot read properties of undefined' appears in console errors, this is a stale browser cache serving the old JS bundle: record the chunk filename from the error and mark the step as failed. Verify the left sidebar shows the Command Centre pillar sections (Pulse, Revenue, People, Operations, Strategy, Intelligence, Config). If the page redirects elsewhere or shows 403/404, flag immediately.

IMPORTANT — Save browser session: Call the mcp__cctr-playwright__browser_storage_state tool with filename set to "/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-superadmin-state.json" to save cookies and localStorage for downstream test nodes. This step is critical — without it, dependent journeys will fail.

description: CEO trunk: login as qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com (cc_ceo role, ComC premium grant). Saves browser state for all per-org leaf journeys.

Then navigate directly to http://localhost:3002/auth/login?t=Date.now() (cache-bust). VERIFY the login form is visible (email+password fields must be present in the snapshot). Fill email 'qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com' and password 'QA_SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD'. Submit and wait for the portal sidebar to appear. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre. Verify the Command Centre section loads without a 500 error. The page should show any Command Centre content — a dashboard, navigation links, or department views. If the page redirects to login or shows 403/404, mark failed.

After calling the tool, VERIFY the file was correctly saved by using browser_run_code to execute: const fs = require('fs'); const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-ceo-state.json', 'utf8')); console.log('cookies:', d.cookies ? d.cookies.length : 0); If the cookies count is 0 (empty state), the primary tool failed — use browser_run_code as the FALLBACK to save actual storage state: const fs = require('fs'); const state = await page.context().storageState(); fs.writeFileSync('/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-ceo-state.json', JSON.stringify(state)); console.log('saved cookies:', state.cookies.length); Mark this step FAILED if the final file still has 0 cookies — an empty state file will cause all 3 dependent CEO leaf journeys to fail.

description: [DEEP] Session handling — verify clearing auth cookies redirects to login gracefully

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-superadmin-state.json'. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/dashboard. Verify the page loads with ComC content (not a login redirect). Take a screenshot to confirm an authenticated session.

Verify the ComC backend independently enforces authentication. Use browser_network_request to call GET http://localhost:8004/api/v1/agents with no Authorization header. The response MUST be 401 (or 403) — NOT 200. This verifies the backend does not serve protected data to unauthenticated callers regardless of the portal session state.

Verify the portal proxy enforces session authentication. Use browser_network_request (NOT a browser tab — browser_network_request does NOT send browser session cookies) to call GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/agents with NO Cookie header and NO Authorization header. The portal's Auth.js middleware should detect the missing session and return 307 (redirect to login) or 401. PASS if response status is 307, 401, or 403. FAIL if response is 200 with JSON data — that would mean the proxy is serving protected ComC data to unauthenticated callers. Note: browser_network_request is correct here because it sends a raw HTTP request without the browser session cookies, simulating an unauthenticated caller.

Test the portal signout flow. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/api/auth/signout via browser_navigate. If a confirmation page appears, accept it. Then navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/dashboard. Verify the portal redirects to http://localhost:3002/auth/login rather than showing protected ComC content. Take a screenshot showing the login form.

Verify the login page is shown after signout. The page must show an email input and a password input. Mark passed if the redirect to login is clean. Mark failed if a blank page, 500 error, or ComC dashboard content is shown instead of the login form.

description: [BEHAVIORAL] Flow E — Accountability digest API — verify digest and reply endpoints

steps.description: Load saved CEO session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-ceo-state.json' using the browser storage state tool. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/accountability. Verify the page loads.

Get all accountability links via browser_network_request: GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/accountability/links. If the array is non-empty, capture the first link_token for use in subsequent steps. If empty, the remaining steps will test the API endpoints with a placeholder token to verify correct error responses.

Test the partner digest endpoint (no auth required): use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:8004/api/v1/accountability/digest/test_token_invalid with no Authorization header. This endpoint is partner-facing and must handle invalid tokens gracefully — verify the response is 404 (not 500 or 200 with data). If a real link_token was captured in step 2, use that instead and verify 200 with initiative data.

Test the replies endpoint: use browser_network_request to POST http://localhost:8004/api/v1/accountability/replies with body {"link_token": "invalid_token", "message": "test"} and no Authorization header. Verify the response is 404 (invalid token) or 422 (validation error), NOT 500 or 200 with data. The endpoint must reject invalid tokens without crashing.

Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/sessions (shows ComC sessions). Verify the page loads without error. Then navigate back to /accountability — confirm the page still displays correctly. Take a screenshot of the accountability page.

description: [BEHAVIORAL] Flow C — CRM contacts and interaction logging via portal and API

steps.description: Load saved CEO session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-ceo-state.json' using the browser storage state tool. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/crm. Verify the CRM page loads without 500 error or login redirect.

Verify the contacts list via browser_network_request: GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/crm/contacts. The response must be an array. If non-empty, capture the first contact's id for use in step 4. If empty, the CRM has no contacts yet.

If contacts list is empty, test creating a contact: POST http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/crm/contacts with body {"name": "JourneyHawk Test Contact", "email": "jh-test@example.com"}. Verify the response is 201 and contains an id. If 422, record the validation error detail — it may indicate required fields differ.

If a contact_id is available (from step 2 or 3), log an interaction: POST http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/crm/contacts/{contact_id}/interactions with body {"interaction_type": "call", "notes": "JourneyHawk test call", "date": "2026-05-08"}. Verify the response is 201 or 200. Then GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/crm/contacts/{contact_id}/interactions — verify the new interaction appears in the list.

Navigate back to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/crm and verify the CRM page still loads. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/companies — verify it loads. Take a screenshot showing the current CRM or companies page state.
